summary.name: MailMaven
summary.one_liner: MailMaven is an email client from SmallCubed, marketed as "The Information Rich Email Client" for power users.
use_cases: find a registration code for MailMaven
read support for MailMaven or legacy MailSuite
summary.what_it_does: The page describes MailMaven as an information-rich email client for power users, offered by developer SmallCubed. It has Download, Support, Upgrade Check and Find Registration Code sections, which suggests it is a downloadable, licensed application with registration keys. The page also lists a legacy product line called MailSuite with its own support and downloads pages. SmallCubed additionally lists Zendesk plugins (RedminePro and Split 'N' Close). The page text gives no feature details, so specific capabilities cannot be confirmed from it.
notable: Developed by SmallCubed, which also makes Zendesk plugins
Has a registration code and upgrade check system, implying a licensed app
Successor to the legacy MailSuite product line
caveats: Page text does not state pricing, platforms or features
Registration code and upgrade flow suggest a paid or licensed product, not confirmed
